PLACEMENT FILE (CSV) FOR THE AOI  -  what it needs
===================================================
This is a PICK & PLACE / centroid file, not a BOM: one row per placed part.
Export it from Altium ("Pick and Place"), KiCad (.pos / Fabrication -> Footprint positions),
Eagle (mountsmd), or MYData/TPSys. Any of these header names are recognised (case ignored):

 REQUIRED
  Designator   : Designator, RefDes, Ref, Reference, Name, Comp
  X  (centre)  : X, Mid X, Center-X(mm), PosX, Ref X
  Y  (centre)  : Y, Mid Y, Center-Y(mm), PosY, Ref Y
 STRONGLY RECOMMENDED
  Rotation     : Rotation, Rot, Angle, Theta       (degrees, counter-clockwise, 0-360)
  Package      : Package, Footprint, Pattern, Case  (0603, SOIC-8, SOT-23, TQFP-64 ... drives box size + checks)
  Value/Part   : Comment, Value, Part Number, Device (shown in reports; "DNF"/"DNP" = part not inspected)
  IPN          : IPN, Internal Part Number, Stock Code, Item  (shown in review + CSV export)
  (Layout "IPN, Comment, Designator, Package, X, Y, Z" works as-is: Z is used as rotation)
 OPTIONAL
  Side         : Layer, Side, TB   (Bottom rows are skipped)

 UNITS    mm, mil or um - detected automatically (units dropdown to force it).
 ORIGIN   any corner; the AOI aligns with fiducials, so only the relative positions matter.
          If boxes come out mirrored, press "Flip Y" in Align.
 FIDUCIALS  name them FID... or use package FIDUCIAL... -> used for automatic alignment.
 SEPARATOR  comma, semicolon or tab. First line with Designator + X + Y = header.

 See placement_template.csv (same folder) for a working example.

WHY ADD A BARE BOARD PHOTO TOO?
  Step 2 -> "Add BARE board": same camera, same position, board with NO parts.
  The AOI compares bare vs golden to find every part exactly, snaps each CSV position
  onto it, sizes the package, and uses "looks like bare board" as the missing-part test.
  Parts it can't match are listed to check by hand.
